message: We joyfully invite you to celebrate the beginning of our forever as we exchange our wedding vows, surrounded by the love of our family and friends. Your presence would be the greatest gift, making this unforgettable day even more meaningful as we begin this beautiful journey together.

story.head: The Beginning
story.text: Two paths crossed on an ordinary day, and from that moment, life became extraordinary. What started as a simple meeting soon grew into a beautiful connection.

story.head: Growing Together
story.text: With every shared laugh, adventure, and heartfelt conversation, our love grew stronger. Together, we built a foundation of trust, happiness, and countless cherished memories.

story.head: Forever Begins
story.text: Surrounded by the love of our family and friends, we are ready to begin the most beautiful chapter of our journey together, becoming husband and wife. We can't wait to celebrate this special day with you.
